note: Negative precedents — requests this authority has declined, with the reason and the routes to try instead. Maintained via adjudication (2026-10-07) and reviewer verdicts. Kernel-generic: any authority may carry this file.

precedents.title: Saving/loading spinner
precedents.reason: Transient persist is terminal feedback; register-derivable (static readout, L-16; notices, L-14). No spinner or toast canon — motion patterns stay deliberately UNDEFINED (L-03).
try: Use a static readout or a ruled notice that changes at the end of the operation (L-14/L-16).
Keep any transient motion minimal and marked; a motion proposal needs evidence plus an L-03 re-evaluation.

precedents.title: Photographic imagery & icon sets
precedents.request: avatar photo; ritual icons; photo upload
precedents.reason: L-21: no imagery; iconography is limited to rhythm glyphs. The absence is honest, not a gap.
try: Use monogram avatars and rhythm glyph marks.
For uploads, use a mark picker rather than photo uploads.

precedents.title: Drag-to-reorder
precedents.reason: No interaction evidence in the restrained register; correctly out (the consumer's adaptation was marked).
try: Prefer explicit move controls, or accept the marked improvisation.
Report recurrence if it should justify interaction canon.

precedents.title: CSV export
precedents.reason: App plumbing, not interface canon; no evidence.
try: Use an existing action (navy or outline) labelled with the concrete verb.
Treat the file mechanics as app utility, outside canon.

precedents.title: Dark mode
precedents.reason: No dark surfaces or theming anywhere in the evidence; re-stating the red/blue roles on an ink ground would be invention.
try: Stay light; map colour roles rather than hexes so future theming is possible.
Use the sanctioned fallbacks and mark the improvisation.

precedents.title: Toggle switch & slider
precedents.reason: The platform-controls fallback is the designed answer; used, marked, reported.
try: Use platform controls styled at field level.

precedents.title: Checkbox & radio
try: Use platform controls styled at field level; mark as fallback.

precedents.title: Date picker & select
precedents.reason: Fallback-covered; the routing nuance has identical constraints/outcome.
try: Use the platform-controls fallback; selects use the existing field-select language.

precedents.title: Destructive confirm pattern (proposal rejected at review)
precedents.request: pattern/destructive-confirm — canonical destructive flow for permanently deleting a ritual (confirm labelled with the concrete verb, never 'OK'; destructive never default-focused)
precedents.reason: Rejected at gate review (no reviewer note recorded); the proposal would have canonised a destructive pattern the register does not evidence.
try: Keep destructive flows inline: confirm via an in-flow ruled panel with explicit verb buttons.
Never pre-focus the destructive control; keep red for attention, not decoration.

precedents.title: Ledger table pattern (proposal rejected at review)
precedents.request: pattern/ledger — table of logged entries (2px ink header rule, hairline rows, red95 hover)
precedents.reason: Rejected at gate review (no reviewer note recorded); the table styling exists only in the sheet layer (L-18) and was declined as canon.
try: Compose tables from typography rules + hairlines (2px header rule, London-85 hairlines) as a marked composition.
Re-propose only if the ledger recurs across consumers and live pages confirm it.
